public_definitions.name: fn_allowance_at
public_definitions.arguments: p_lng double precision, p_lat double precision
public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_allowance_at(p_lng double precision, p_lat double precision)
 RETURNS TABLE(allowance_type text, name text, mandal text, district text, go_reference text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select v.allowance_type, v.name, v.mandal, v.district, v.go_reference
  from village_allowance v
  where ST_Intersects(v.geom, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p_lng,p_lat),4326)::geography)
  order by (v.allowance_type is not null) desc
  limit 1;
$function$

public_definitions.name: fn_flyash_required
public_definitions.arguments: p_lng double precision, p_lat double precision
public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_flyash_required(p_lng double precision, p_lat double precision)
 RETURNS TABLE(required boolean, nearest_plant text, distance_km numeric, radius_km numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  with r as (select coalesce(radius_km,100) km from material_policy where code='FLYASH_BRICKS'),
       pt as (select ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(p_lng,p_lat),4326)::geography g)
  select (n.dist_km <= (select km from r)) as required, n.name, round(n.dist_km::numeric,1), (select km from r)
  from (
    select t.name, ST_Distance(t.geom, pt.g)/1000.0 as dist_km
    from thermal_power_plant t, pt
    order by t.geom <-> pt.g limit 1
  ) n;
$function$

public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_gst_rate(p_recipient text, p_earthwork boolean DEFAULT false, p_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  select rate_pct from gst_rate
  where recipient_type = p_recipient
    and earthwork_predominant = p_earthwork
    and effective_from <= p_date
    and (effective_to is null or effective_to > p_date)
  order by effective_from desc limit 1;
$function$

public_definitions.name: fn_trial_pit_extra
public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_trial_pit_extra(p_depth_m numeric)
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, value_pct numeric, description text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT code, value_pct, description
  FROM public.excavation_extra
  WHERE category = 'TRIAL_PIT'
    AND sor_year = (
      SELECT sor_year
      FROM public.excavation_extra
      ORDER BY effective_from DESC, sor_year DESC
      LIMIT 1
    )
    AND p_depth_m > COALESCE(depth_min_m, -1)
    AND p_depth_m <= COALESCE(depth_max_m, 1e9)
  ORDER BY depth_min_m
  LIMIT 1;
$function$

public_definitions.name: rebuild_ssr_seigniorage_policy
public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rebuild_ssr_seigniorage_policy(p_code text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
WITH source_materials AS (
  SELECT
    s.code AS ssr_code,
    s.unit AS item_output_unit,
    NULLIF(regexp_replace(coalesce(s.quantity::text, ''), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g'), '')::numeric
      AS item_output_qty,
    m.ordinality::integer AS material_index,
    trim(coalesce(m.value->>'desc', m.value->>'description', '')) AS recipe_material_desc,
    trim(coalesce(m.value->>'unit', '')) AS recipe_material_unit,
    CASE
      WHEN regexp_replace(coalesce(m.value->>'quantity', ''), '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g')
        ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
      THEN regexp_replace(m.value->>'quantity', '[^0-9.\-]', '', 'g')::numeric
      ELSE NULL
    END AS recipe_material_qty
  FROM public.ssr_item s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(s.materials, '[]'::jsonb))
    WITH ORDINALITY AS m(value, ordinality)
  WHERE p_code IS NULL OR s.code = p_code
),
classified AS (
  SELECT
    sm.*,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(sm.recipe_material_desc) ~ 'sand\s+bag' THEN NULL
      WHEN lower(sm.recipe_material_desc) ~ '(fine aggregate|sand\s*\((un-)?screened|sand for filling|(^|[^a-z])sand($|[^a-z]))'
        THEN 'SAND_FINE_AGGREGATE'
      WHEN lower(sm.recipe_material_desc) ~ '(murrum|murum|moorum|morram|ordinary earth|borrow earth|(^|[^a-z])earth($|[^a-z])|(^|[^a-z])soil($|[^a-z]))'
        THEN 'SOIL_MORRAM_EARTH'
      WHEN lower(sm.recipe_material_desc) ~ '(coarse aggregate|stone chips?|rubble|rough stones?|uncoursed rubble|coursed rubble|road metal|ballast|boulders?|plums?|khandki|header stones?|through stones?|pin headers?|stone slab|filter\s*\(\s*available|[0-9]+[ -]*mm down filter)'
        THEN 'STONE_AGGREGATE'
      WHEN lower(sm.recipe_material_desc) ~ 'laterite'
        THEN 'LATERITE'
      WHEN lower(sm.recipe_material_desc) ~ 'lime\s*stone slab|limestone slab'
        THEN 'LIMESTONE_SLAB'
      ELSE NULL
    END AS material_key
  FROM source_materials sm
  WHERE sm.recipe_material_qty IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.recipe_material_qty > 0
    AND sm.item_output_qty IS NOT NULL
    AND sm.item_output_qty > 0
),
recipe_groups AS (
  SELECT
    ssr_code,
    material_key,
    max(item_output_unit) AS item_output_unit,
    max(item_output_qty) AS item_output_qty,
    sum(recipe_material_qty) AS recipe_material_qty,
    string_agg(recipe_material_desc, ' | ' ORDER BY material_index) AS recipe_material_desc,
    (array_agg(recipe_material_unit ORDER BY material_index))[1] AS recipe_material_unit
  FROM classified
  WHERE material_key IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ssr_code, material_key
),
imported_description_value_rows AS (
  SELECT
    s.code AS ssr_code,
    value->>'material_key' AS material_key,
    NULLIF(value->>'material_label', '') AS description_label,
    (value->>'quantity')::numeric AS description_quantity,
    coalesce(value->>'unit', 'CUM') AS description_quantity_unit,
    value->>'source_text' AS description_source_text,
    value->'blend_ratio' AS description_blend_ratio
  FROM public.ssr_item s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(
    CASE
      WHEN jsonb_typeof(s.description_quantity_policy->'values') = 'array'
        THEN s.description_quantity_policy->'values'
      ELSE '[]'::jsonb
    END
  ) AS parsed(value)
  WHERE s.description_quantity_policy->>'description_hash' = md5(
    regexp_replace(trim(coalesce(s.description, '')), '\s+', ' ', 'g')
  )
    AND (value->>'quantity') ~ '^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$'
    AND (value->>'quantity')::numeric > 0
),
imported_description_values AS (
  SELECT
    ssr_code,
    material_key,
    max(description_label) AS description_label,
    sum(description_quantity) AS description_quantity,
    max(description_quantity_unit) AS description_quantity_unit,
    string_agg(description_source_text, ' | ' ORDER BY description_source_text)
      AS description_source_text,
    (array_agg(description_blend_ratio ORDER BY description_source_text))[1]
      AS description_blend_ratio
  FROM imported_description_value_rows
  GROUP BY ssr_code, material_key
),
legacy_description_values AS (
  -- Compatibility path for ssr_item rows imported before the extractor field
  -- existed. New imports use description_quantity_policy above.
  SELECT
    s.code AS ssr_code,
    'STONE_AGGREGATE' AS material_key,
    'Coarse aggregate' AS description_label,
    ((regexp_match(
      s.description,
      '(?i)(?:CA|coarse\s+aggregates?)\s*[:=-]\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(?:cum|cu\.?\s*m|m3|m³)'
    ))[1])::numeric AS description_quantity,
    'CUM' AS description_quantity_unit,
    (regexp_match(
      s.description,
      '(?i)((?:CA|coarse\s+aggregates?)\s*[:=-]\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?\s*(?:cum|cu\.?\s*m|m3|m³))'
    ))[1] AS description_source_text,
    (
      SELECT to_jsonb(regexp_split_to_array(
        regexp_replace((regexp_match(
          s.description,
          '(?i)(?:blending\s+ratio\s+of\s+)?CA\s*(?:--?|:)\s*([0-9]+\s*:\s*[0-9]+(?:\s*:\s*[0-9]+)*)'
        ))[1], '\s+', '', 'g'), ':'
      ))
    ) AS description_blend_ratio
  FROM public.ssr_item s
  WHERE s.description ~* '(?:CA|coarse\s+aggregates?)\s*[:=-]\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?\s*(?:cum|cu\.?\s*m|m3|m³)'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    s.code,
    'SAND_FINE_AGGREGATE',
    'Fine aggregate',
    ((regexp_match(
      s.description,
      '(?i)(?:FA|fine\s+aggregates?|sand)\s*[:=-]\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)\s*(?:cum|cu\.?\s*m|m3|m³)'
    ))[1])::numeric,
    'CUM',
    (regexp_match(
      s.description,
      '(?i)((?:FA|fine\s+aggregates?|sand)\s*[:=-]\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?\s*(?:cum|cu\.?\s*m|m3|m³))'
    ))[1],
    NULL::jsonb
  FROM public.ssr_item s
  WHERE s.description ~* '(?:FA|fine\s+aggregates?|sand)\s*[:=-]\s*[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?\s*(?:cum|cu\.?\s*m|m3|m³)'
),
description_values AS (
  SELECT * FROM imported_description_values
  UNION ALL
  SELECT legacy.*
  FROM legacy_description_values legacy
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM imported_description_values imported
    WHERE imported.ssr_code = legacy.ssr_code
  )
),
policy_rows AS (
  SELECT
    rg.*,
    dv.description_label,
    dv.description_quantity,
    dv.description_quantity_unit,
    dv.description_source_text,
    dv.description_blend_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN dv.description_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN dv.description_quantity
      ELSE round(rg.recipe_material_qty / NULLIF(rg.item_output_qty, 0), 8)
    END AS quantity_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN dv.description_quantity IS NOT NULL THEN 'SSR_DESCRIPTION'
      ELSE 'SSR_RECIPE_MATERIALS'
    END AS quantity_ratio_source
  FROM recipe_groups rg
  LEFT JOIN description_values dv
    ON dv.ssr_code = rg.ssr_code
   AND dv.material_key = rg.material_key
),
policies AS (
  SELECT
    s.code AS ssr_code,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'schema_version', 4,
      'source', 'SSR_DESCRIPTION',
      'parser_version', coalesce(
        s.description_quantity_policy->>'parser_version',
        'ssr-description-quantity-v2'
      ),
      'description_hash', md5(regexp_replace(trim(coalesce(s.description, '')), '\s+', ' ', 'g')),
      'approval_status', CASE
        WHEN count(pr.material_key) = 0 THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'
        WHEN bool_and(pr.description_quantity IS NOT NULL) THEN 'APPROVED'
        ELSE 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
      END,
      'policy_basis', jsonb_build_object(
        'purpose', 'MATERIAL_SUPPLY',
        'evidence', jsonb_build_array('SSR item description'),
        'review_status', CASE
          WHEN count(pr.material_key) = 0 THEN 'NOT_APPLICABLE'
          WHEN bool_and(pr.description_quantity IS NOT NULL) THEN 'APPROVED'
          ELSE 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
        END
      ),
      'applicable', count(pr.material_key) > 0,
      'materials', coalesce(
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'material_key', pr.material_key,
            'material_label', coalesce(pr.description_label, CASE pr.material_key
              WHEN 'SAND_FINE_AGGREGATE' THEN 'Sand'
              WHEN 'SOIL_MORRAM_EARTH' THEN 'Soil / murram / earth'
              WHEN 'STONE_AGGREGATE' THEN 'Stone / aggregate'
              WHEN 'LATERITE' THEN 'Laterite'
              WHEN 'LIMESTONE_SLAB' THEN 'Limestone slab'
              ELSE 'Review required'
            END),
            'recipe_material_desc', pr.recipe_material_desc,
            'recipe_material_unit', pr.recipe_material_unit,
            'recipe_material_qty', pr.recipe_material_qty,
            'item_output_unit', pr.item_output_unit,
            'item_output_qty', pr.item_output_qty,
            'quantity_ratio', pr.quantity_ratio,
            'quantity_ratio_source', pr.quantity_ratio_source,
            'description_quantity', pr.description_quantity,
            'description_quantity_unit', pr.description_quantity_unit,
            'description_source_text', pr.description_source_text,
            'description_blend_ratio', pr.description_blend_ratio,
            'seig_code', CASE pr.material_key
              WHEN 'SAND_FINE_AGGREGATE' THEN 'SEIG_SAND_OTHERS'
              WHEN 'SOIL_MORRAM_EARTH' THEN 'SEIG_MORRAM_GRAVEL_EARTH'
              WHEN 'STONE_AGGREGATE' THEN 'SEIG_BUILDING_STONE'
              WHEN 'LATERITE' THEN 'SEIG_LATERITE'
              WHEN 'LIMESTONE_SLAB' THEN 'SEIG_LIMESTONE_SLABS'
              ELSE NULL
            END,
            'quantity_unit', coalesce(pr.description_quantity_unit, upper(nullif(pr.recipe_material_unit, ''))),
            'charge_unit', coalesce(pr.description_quantity_unit, upper(nullif(pr.recipe_material_unit, ''))),
            'conversion_factor', CASE
              WHEN lower(coalesce(pr.description_quantity_unit, pr.recipe_material_unit)) = 'kg' THEN 0.001
              ELSE 1
            END,
            'mode', CASE
              WHEN pr.description_quantity IS NULL THEN 'RECIPE_MATERIAL_RATIO'
              ELSE 'DESCRIPTION_MATERIAL_RATIO'
            END,
            'quantity_basis', 'ITEM_QTY_X_RATIO',
            'status', CASE
              WHEN pr.description_quantity IS NULL THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
              ELSE 'APPROVED'
            END,
            'approval_status', CASE
              WHEN pr.description_quantity IS NULL THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED'
              ELSE 'APPROVED'
            END,
            'notes', CASE
              WHEN pr.description_quantity IS NULL THEN 'No approved quantity was parsed from the SSR description; recipe material quantity is used pending review.'
              ELSE 'Approved SSR description quantity used for calculation.'
            END
          ) ORDER BY pr.material_key
        ) FILTER (WHERE pr.material_key IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'rows', coalesce(
        jsonb_agg(
          jsonb_build_object(
            'material_key', pr.material_key,
            'material_label', coalesce(pr.description_label, pr.material_key),
            'recipe_material_desc', pr.recipe_material_desc,
            'recipe_material_unit', pr.recipe_material_unit,
            'recipe_material_qty', pr.recipe_material_qty,
            'item_output_qty', pr.item_output_qty,
            'quantity_ratio', pr.quantity_ratio,
            'quantity_ratio_source', pr.quantity_ratio_source,
            'description_quantity', pr.description_quantity,
            'description_quantity_unit', pr.description_quantity_unit,
            'description_source_text', pr.description_source_text,
            'description_blend_ratio', pr.description_blend_ratio,
            'seig_code', CASE pr.material_key
              WHEN 'SAND_FINE_AGGREGATE' THEN 'SEIG_SAND_OTHERS'
              WHEN 'SOIL_MORRAM_EARTH' THEN 'SEIG_MORRAM_GRAVEL_EARTH'
              WHEN 'STONE_AGGREGATE' THEN 'SEIG_BUILDING_STONE'
              WHEN 'LATERITE' THEN 'SEIG_LATERITE'
              WHEN 'LIMESTONE_SLAB' THEN 'SEIG_LIMESTONE_SLABS'
              ELSE NULL
            END,
            'quantity_unit', coalesce(pr.description_quantity_unit, upper(nullif(pr.recipe_material_unit, ''))),
            'charge_unit', coalesce(pr.description_quantity_unit, upper(nullif(pr.recipe_material_unit, ''))),
            'conversion_factor', 1,
            'mode', CASE WHEN pr.description_quantity IS NULL
              THEN 'RECIPE_MATERIAL_RATIO' ELSE 'DESCRIPTION_MATERIAL_RATIO' END,
            'quantity_basis', 'ITEM_QTY_X_RATIO',
            'status', CASE WHEN pr.description_quantity IS NULL
              THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'APPROVED' END,
            'approval_status', CASE WHEN pr.description_quantity IS NULL
              THEN 'REVIEW_REQUIRED' ELSE 'APPROVED' END
          ) ORDER BY pr.material_key
        ) FILTER (WHERE pr.material_key IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::jsonb
      ),
      'generated_at', to_char(now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS"Z"')
    ) AS policy
  FROM public.ssr_item s
  LEFT JOIN policy_rows pr ON pr.ssr_code = s.code
  WHERE p_code IS NULL OR s.code = p_code
  GROUP BY s.code, s.description, s.description_quantity_policy
)
UPDATE public.ssr_item s
SET seigniorage_applicability = policies.policy
FROM policies
WHERE policies.ssr_code = s.code
  -- Leave lead-only, direct-quantity, and other non-material policies intact.
  AND jsonb_array_length(policies.policy->'rows') > 0;
$function$

public_definitions.name: sor_centering_recipe_addon_valid
public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_centering_recipe_addon_valid(spec jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE review jsonb := spec->'review';
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(spec) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
    NOT(spec ?& ARRAY['schema_version','rule_code','applies_to_recipe_code','kind','threshold_m','increment_m','percentage','partial_increment','compounding','rounding','review']) OR
    spec-ARRAY['schema_version','rule_code','applies_to_recipe_code','kind','threshold_m','increment_m','percentage','partial_increment','compounding','rounding','review']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF spec->'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb OR spec->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'centering_extra_height'
    OR spec->>'partial_increment' IS NULL OR spec->>'partial_increment' NOT IN ('ceil','exact_only') OR spec->'compounding' IS DISTINCT FROM 'false'::jsonb
    OR spec->>'rounding' IS DISTINCT FROM 'component_paise_half_up'
    OR jsonb_typeof(spec->'threshold_m') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR jsonb_typeof(spec->'increment_m') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number'
    OR jsonb_typeof(spec->'percentage') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF (spec->>'threshold_m')::numeric<=0 OR (spec->>'increment_m')::numeric<=0 OR (spec->>'percentage')::numeric<=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce(jsonb_typeof(spec->'rule_code')='string' AND jsonb_typeof(spec->'applies_to_recipe_code')='string'
    AND length(trim(spec->>'rule_code'))>0 AND length(trim(spec->>'applies_to_recipe_code'))>0
    AND jsonb_typeof(review)='object' AND review->>'status' IN ('approved','source_clarification')
    AND review->'reviewer'->>'kind'='ai' AND length(review->>'review_id')=64
    AND length(review->>'source_pdf_sha256')=64 AND length(trim(review->>'source_note'))>0
    AND length(trim(review->>'reason'))>0 AND jsonb_typeof(review->'source_pdf_page')='number',false);
END $function$

public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_machinery_details_valid(totals jsonb, details jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
select case when jsonb_typeof(totals) = 'object' and jsonb_typeof(details) = 'object' then
  coalesce(
    totals ?& array['zone_1','zone_2','zone_3']
    and details ?& array['zone_1','zone_2','zone_3']
    and details - array['zone_1','zone_2','zone_3'] = '{}'::jsonb
    and not exists (
      select 1 from (values ('zone_1'),('zone_2'),('zone_3')) as zones(z)
      where case when jsonb_typeof(details->z) = 'object' then
        not coalesce(
          (details->z) ?& array['hire_charge','fuel_charge','crew_charge']
          and (details->z) - array['hire_charge','fuel_charge','crew_charge'] = '{}'::jsonb
          and jsonb_typeof(details->z->'hire_charge') in ('number','null')
          and jsonb_typeof(details->z->'fuel_charge') in ('number','null')
          and jsonb_typeof(details->z->'crew_charge') in ('number','null')
          and jsonb_typeof(totals->z) in ('number','null')
          and case when jsonb_typeof(totals->z) = 'number'
                    and jsonb_typeof(details->z->'hire_charge') = 'number'
                    and jsonb_typeof(details->z->'fuel_charge') = 'number'
                    and jsonb_typeof(details->z->'crew_charge') = 'number' then
            (totals->>z)::numeric = (details->z->>'hire_charge')::numeric
                + (details->z->>'fuel_charge')::numeric + (details->z->>'crew_charge')::numeric
          else true end, false)
      else true end
    ), false)
else false end;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_morth_analysis_rate_valid(v jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE STRICT
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
declare o jsonb; codes text[]:=array[]::text[]; s jsonb;
begin
 if jsonb_typeof(v) is distinct from 'object' or not(v ?& array['schema_version','type','status','options','requirements','reason'])
  or (v-array['schema_version','type','status','options','requirements','reason'])<>'{}'::jsonb
  or v->'schema_version' is distinct from '1'::jsonb or v->>'type' is distinct from 'morth_analysis'
  or coalesce(v->>'status','') not in ('scope_review_required','no_matching_analysis')
  or jsonb_typeof(v->'options') is distinct from 'array'
  or jsonb_typeof(v->'requirements') is distinct from 'array'
  or jsonb_typeof(v->'reason') is distinct from 'string' or length(btrim(v->>'reason'))=0 then return false; end if;
 if jsonb_array_length(v->'options')>512 or jsonb_array_length(v->'requirements')=0
  or ((jsonb_array_length(v->'options')>0)<>(v->>'status'='scope_review_required')) then return false; end if;
 for s in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v->'requirements') loop
  if jsonb_typeof(s)<>'string' or length(btrim(s#>>'{}'))=0 then return false; end if;
 end loop;
 for o in select value from jsonb_array_elements(v->'options') loop
  if jsonb_typeof(o) is distinct from 'object'
   or not(o ?& array['morth_code','relationship','review_status','source_pages','source_edition'])
   or (o-array['morth_code','relationship','review_status','source_pages','source_edition'])<>'{}'::jsonb
   or jsonb_typeof(o->'morth_code') is distinct from 'string' or (o->>'morth_code')!~'^MORTH-.+'
   or coalesce(o->>'relationship','') not in ('whole_work_candidate','component_candidate')
   or o->>'review_status' is distinct from 'scope_review_required'
   or jsonb_typeof(o->'source_edition') is distinct from 'string' or length(btrim(o->>'source_edition'))=0
   or jsonb_typeof(o->'source_pages') not in ('array','object')
   or o->'source_pages' in ('[]'::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)
   or (o->>'morth_code')=any(codes) then return false; end if;
  codes:=array_append(codes,o->>'morth_code');
 end loop;
 return true;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_morth_referenced_key_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
begin
 if tg_op='UPDATE' and new.code=old.code and new.recipe->>'source_edition' is not distinct from old.source_edition
  and new.recipe->'source_pages' is not distinct from old.source_pages then return new; end if;
 if exists(select 1 from public."SOR_Year" y cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(y.rate->'options','[]'::jsonb)) o
  where y.rate->>'type'='morth_analysis' and o->>'morth_code'=old.code) then
  raise exception 'MoRTH key/source is referenced by reviewed SOR annual analysis links; reconcile before changing it';
 end if;
 if tg_op='DELETE' then return old; end if; return new;
end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_plumbing_porcelain_rule_valid(spec jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE review jsonb:=spec->'review';
BEGIN
 IF jsonb_typeof(spec) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object' OR
 NOT(spec ?& ARRAY['schema_version','rule_code','applies_to_recipe_code','kind','percentage','basis','when','excludes','review']) OR
 spec-ARRAY['schema_version','rule_code','applies_to_recipe_code','kind','percentage','basis','when','excludes','review']<>'{}'::jsonb THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF spec->'schema_version' IS DISTINCT FROM '1'::jsonb OR spec->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM 'coloured_porcelain'
 OR spec->>'basis' IS DISTINCT FROM 'white_porcelain_component'
 OR spec->'when' IS DISTINCT FROM '{"colour":"coloured"}'::jsonb
 OR spec->'excludes' IS DISTINCT FROM '["fittings"]'::jsonb
 OR jsonb_typeof(spec->'percentage') IS DISTINCT FROM 'number' THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 IF (spec->>'percentage')::numeric<=0 THEN RETURN false; END IF;
 RETURN coalesce(jsonb_typeof(spec->'rule_code')='string' AND length(trim(spec->>'rule_code'))>0
 AND jsonb_typeof(spec->'applies_to_recipe_code')='string' AND length(trim(spec->>'applies_to_recipe_code'))>0
 AND review->>'status'='approved' AND review->'reviewer'->>'kind'='ai'
 AND length(review->>'review_id')=64 AND length(review->>'source_pdf_sha256')=64
 AND length(trim(review->>'source_note'))>0 AND length(trim(review->>'reason'))>0,false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_recipe_protect_lead_target()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SOR_Lead_Rule" r CROSS JOIN LATERAL public.sor_lead_rule_codes(r.rules) code WHERE code=old.recipe_code) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conveyance Recipe is referenced by a shared lead rule'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SOR_Recipie" r WHERE r.variants->>'main_recipe_code'=old.recipe_code AND r.recipe_code<>old.recipe_code) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recipe is an actual variant family anchor'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SOR_Recipie" r WHERE
  COALESCE(r.addons->'recipe_codes','[]'::jsonb) ? old.recipe_code OR
  COALESCE(r.addons->'rule'->'applies_to','[]'::jsonb) ? old.recipe_code OR
  COALESCE(r.addons->'rule'->'requires','[]'::jsonb) ? old.recipe_code) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Recipe is referenced by an addon relationship'; END IF;
 RETURN old;
END $function$

public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_recipe_revision_chain_valid()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- This is deferred so all siblings can be inserted in one transaction.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SOR_Recipie" child,
  LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(public.sor_revision_replacements(child.recipe_revision,child.recipe_code)) c
  LEFT JOIN public."SOR_Recipie" sibling ON sibling.recipe_code=c
  WHERE child.recipe_revision->>'schema_version'='2'
  AND (sibling.recipe_code IS NULL OR public.sor_revision_core(sibling.recipe_revision) IS DISTINCT FROM public.sor_revision_core(child.recipe_revision))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every split/merge successor must carry the identical complete revision group'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SOR_Recipie" child,
  LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(public.sor_revision_previous(child.recipe_revision)) c
  JOIN public."SOR_Recipie" parent ON parent.recipe_code=c
  WHERE parent.recipe_revision IS NOT NULL AND public.sor_fiscal_start(parent.recipe_revision->>'effective_from_year')
   >=public.sor_fiscal_start(child.recipe_revision->>'effective_from_year')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Revision chain boundaries must strictly increase; cycles are prohibited'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SOR_Recipie" a JOIN public."SOR_Recipie" b ON a.recipe_code<b.recipe_code
  AND public.sor_revision_previous(a.recipe_revision) ?| ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(public.sor_revision_previous(b.recipe_revision)))
  WHERE a.recipe_revision IS NOT NULL AND b.recipe_revision IS NOT NULL
  AND (a.recipe_revision->>'schema_version'<>'2' OR public.sor_revision_core(b.recipe_revision) IS DISTINCT FROM public.sor_revision_core(a.recipe_revision))) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conflicting revision branches; author one complete reviewed replacement group'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(WITH RECURSIVE edges AS (
 SELECT r.recipe_code AS origin,f.value->>'target_recipe_code' AS target,y.value AS year
 FROM public."SOR_Recipie" r CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(r.recipe_revision->'historical_fallbacks','[]'::jsonb)) f
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(f.value->'years') y), walk AS (
 SELECT origin,target,year,ARRAY[origin]::text[] path,target=origin cycle FROM edges
 UNION ALL SELECT w.origin,e.target,w.year,w.path||w.target,e.target=ANY(w.path||w.target)
 FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.origin=w.target AND e.year=w.year WHERE NOT w.cycle)
 SELECT 1 FROM walk WHERE cycle) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Historical fallback cycle'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.sor_single_machinery_details_valid(totals jsonb, details jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
SELECT CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(totals)='number' AND jsonb_typeof(details)='object' THEN
CASE WHEN details ?& ARRAY['hire_charge','fuel_charge','crew_charge']
 AND details-ARRAY['hire_charge','fuel_charge','crew_charge']='{}'::jsonb
 AND jsonb_typeof(details->'hire_charge')='number'
 AND jsonb_typeof(details->'fuel_charge')='number'
 AND jsonb_typeof(details->'crew_charge')='number' THEN
 (totals #>> '{}')::numeric >= 0
 AND (details->>'hire_charge')::numeric>=0
 AND (details->>'fuel_charge')::numeric>=0
 AND (details->>'crew_charge')::numeric>=0
 AND (totals #>> '{}')::numeric=(details->>'hire_charge')::numeric
   +(details->>'fuel_charge')::numeric+(details->>'crew_charge')::numeric
 ELSE false END ELSE false END;
$function$

public_definitions.name: ssr_annotate_resource_lines
public_definitions.arguments: p_ssr_code text, p_analysis_scope text, p_year text, p_lines jsonb
public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ssr_annotate_resource_lines(p_ssr_code text, p_analysis_scope text, p_year text, p_lines jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  select coalesce(jsonb_agg(
    line.value || jsonb_build_object('resource_identity',
      case when jsonb_typeof(line.value->'resource_identity')='object'
        and (
          (nullif(resolved.identity->>'master_code','') is not null
           and line.value->'resource_identity'->>'source_table'
               is not distinct from resolved.identity->>'source_table'
           and line.value->'resource_identity'->>'master_code'
               is not distinct from resolved.identity->>'master_code'
           and line.value->'resource_identity'->>'rate_component'
               is not distinct from resolved.identity->>'rate_component')
          or (nullif(resolved.identity->>'resource_key','') is not null
           and nullif(resolved.identity->>'master_code','') is null
           and nullif(line.value->'resource_identity'->>'master_code','') is null
           and line.value->'resource_identity'->>'resource_key'
               = resolved.identity->>'resource_key')
        )
      then (line.value->'resource_identity') || case when resolved.identity->>'source_table'='analysis_resource' and not (line.value->'resource_identity' ? 'recipe_code') then resolved.identity-'recipe_code' else resolved.identity end || case when line.value->'resource_identity'->>'resolution'='master_code' and resolved.identity->>'resolution' in ('recipe_code','source_resource') then jsonb_build_object('resolution','master_code') else '{}'::jsonb end
      else resolved.identity end
    ) order by line.ordinality
  ),'[]'::jsonb)
  from jsonb_array_elements(public.ssr_resource_line_array(p_lines))
    with ordinality as line(value,ordinality)
  cross join lateral (
    select case
      when nullif(line.value->'resource_identity'->>'master_code','') is null
       and (line.value->'resource_identity'->>'resource_key') ~ '^ssr:[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+:[a-z0-9-]+-[a-f0-9]{12}$'
       and nullif(candidate.identity->>'master_code','') is null
       and nullif(candidate.identity->>'resource_key','') is not null
      then public.ssr_curated_resource_identity(line.value->'resource_identity'->>'resource_key')
      else candidate.identity end as identity
    from (select public.ssr_resolve_resource_identity(
      p_ssr_code,p_analysis_scope,p_year,line.value
    ) as identity offset 0) candidate
    offset 0
  ) resolved;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ssr_identity_from_resource_key(p_ssr_code text, p_analysis_scope text, p_line jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_resource_key text;
begin
  select resource_key
  into v_resource_key
  from public.ssr_resource_key
  where ssr_code = p_ssr_code
    and analysis_scope = p_analysis_scope
    and description_key = public.ssr_normalize_resource_text(p_line ->> 'desc')
    and unit_key = public.ssr_normalize_resource_text(p_line ->> 'unit');
  if v_resource_key is null then
    return null;
  end if;
  return public.ssr_curated_resource_identity(v_resource_key);
end;
$function$

public_definitions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ssr_recipe_link_chain_valid()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 -- This is deferred so all siblings can be inserted in one transaction.
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SSR_Recipe" child,
  LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(public.ssr_recipe_replacements(child.ssr_recipe_link,child.recipe_code)) c
  LEFT JOIN public."SSR_Recipe" sibling ON sibling.recipe_code=c
  WHERE child.ssr_recipe_link->>'schema_version'='2'
  AND (sibling.recipe_code IS NULL OR sibling.ssr_recipe_link IS DISTINCT FROM child.ssr_recipe_link)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Every split/merge successor must carry the identical complete revision group'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SSR_Recipe" child,
  LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(public.ssr_recipe_previous(child.ssr_recipe_link)) c
  JOIN public."SSR_Recipe" parent ON parent.recipe_code=c
  WHERE parent.ssr_recipe_link IS NOT NULL AND public.sor_fiscal_start(parent.ssr_recipe_link->>'effective_from_year')
   >=public.sor_fiscal_start(child.ssr_recipe_link->>'effective_from_year')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Revision chain boundaries must strictly increase; cycles are prohibited'; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public."SSR_Recipe" a JOIN public."SSR_Recipe" b ON a.recipe_code<b.recipe_code
  AND public.ssr_recipe_previous(a.ssr_recipe_link) ?| ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_array_elements_text(public.ssr_recipe_previous(b.ssr_recipe_link)))
  WHERE a.ssr_recipe_link IS NOT NULL AND b.ssr_recipe_link IS NOT NULL
  AND (a.ssr_recipe_link->>'schema_version'<>'2' OR b.ssr_recipe_link IS DISTINCT FROM a.ssr_recipe_link)) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'Conflicting revision branches; author one complete reviewed replacement group'; END IF;
 RETURN NULL;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ssr_static_resource_lines(p_ssr_code text, p_analysis_scope text)
 RETURNS SETOF jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_scope text[];
begin
  if p_analysis_scope = 'materials' then
    return query
      select line.value from public.ssr_item item
      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(public.ssr_resource_line_array(item.materials)) line
      where item.code = p_ssr_code;
  elsif p_analysis_scope = 'machinery' then
    return query
      select line.value from public.ssr_item item
      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(public.ssr_resource_line_array(item.machinery)) line
      where item.code = p_ssr_code;
  elsif p_analysis_scope = 'labour' then
    return query
      select line.value from public.ssr_item item
      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(public.ssr_resource_line_array(item.labour)) line
      where item.code = p_ssr_code;
  end if;

  v_scope := regexp_match(p_analysis_scope, '^addon:([^:]+):(materials|machinery|labour)$');
  if v_scope is not null then
    return query
      select line.value from public.ssr_item item
      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(public.ssr_resource_line_array(item.addon_table)) addon
      cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(public.ssr_resource_line_array(addon.value -> v_scope[2])) line
      where item.code = p_ssr_code
        and addon.value ->> 'id' = v_scope[1];
  end if;
end;
$function$
